data.message: All 24 others: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Will you each state your exact intended catch and any conditions? Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, that's50 left and next stock500 or100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation.
